nodes.name: drill.py
nodes.summary: Stress drill (tests/stress): legacy version of test_v2/stress/drill.py. Sustained load generator for AI pipeline with QPS control and quota monitoring. Superseded by test_v2 version.

nodes.name: prov.py
nodes.summary: Stress provenance test: validates provenance tracking under load. Checks that request IDs, key rotations, and quota states are correctly maintained across concurrent requests. Outputs provenance_validation.json.

nodes.name: stress.py
nodes.summary: Stress test framework (tests/stress): legacy version of test_v2/stress/stress.py. Base class for stress tests with worker pool, result aggregation, metrics collection, and HTML report generation. Superseded by test_v2 version.

nodes.name: stress3.py
nodes.summary: Stress test v3 (tests/stress): legacy version of test_v2/stress/stress3.py. Multi-scenario stress test (burst, sustained, ramp-up, soak). Tests quota rotation under concurrent load. Superseded by test_v2 version.

nodes.name: RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Stress test results: documents stress test runs with QPS targets, error rates, latency percentiles (p50, p95, p99), quota consumption per key, GPU memory usage, and pass/fail criteria. Records key rotation fairness under load.

nodes.name: RESULTS.md
nodes.summary: Token usage test results: tracks token consumption per query type (DB_ONLY, DOC_ONLY, HYBRID), per model (Gemma-4-31B, Flash-Lite), and per pipeline stage. Used to optimize prompts and estimate costs. Records input/output token ratios.
